notes: ACCESS: robots.txt at https://www.pbteen.com/robots.txt checked first - no ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai/Claude-Web/Claude-User/Claude-SearchBot directive of any kind (only EasouSpider and Pinterestbot named); generic User-agent:* allows crawling except account/checkout/service paths. Site loaded fine in Chrome, no block encountered. TREE: built from union of top mega-menu (Dorm, Furniture, Bedding, Desks & Study, Decor, Lighting, Rugs, Windows, Bath, Storage, Gifts, Backpacks & Lunch) plus each landing page's own hidden sub-nav (captured via accessibility-tree read_page dumps, which exposed full submenu href lists even when not visually open) plus each category page's own pill/filter sub-nav. Furniture, Lighting, Kitchen&Dining-style items, Gifts, Backpacks&Lunch, Desks&Study (all furniture+generic decor), Bathroom fixtures/mirrors, and Wall Decor/Decorative-Accessories-only nodes were out of scope and skipped. QTY: taken from each leaf's own rendered '<Title> NN Items' header text (evidence recorded per row); several 'header-category' landing hubs (e.g. Dorm Storage & Organization, Dorm Curtains, Dorm Rugs, Dorm Bath & Laundry) had no own product count and only linked to ugly producttype-facet URLs with no clean slug, so per URL rules (no search/facet-result URLs) their children (Trunks, Under-Bed Storage, Shelves & Wall Organization) were left out rather than guessed. EXCLUDED-AS-DUPLICATE (same physical inventory reachable via a second nav path, to avoid double counting): Decor > 'Pillows & Throw Blankets' (redirects to /shop/accessories/new-pillows-throws/, 157 items) is almost exactly Bedding's own Decorative Pillows(108)+Blankets & Throws(50)=158 - treated as a cross-listing of the Bedding subcategories and dropped. Decor > Storage > 'Bathroom & Laundry' (/shop/accessories/bathroom-and-laundry/, 102 items) overlaps Bath's own Bathroom Storage+Accessories(59)+Hampers&Laundry Bags(54) - dropped in favor of the more granular Bath-tree entries. Decor > Storage > 'Bins, Baskets & Organizers' (/shop/accessories/bins-baskets-organizers/, 96 items) overlaps Storage's own 'Teen Storage Bins & Baskets' (76 items, different URL/count but same product domain) - dropped in favor of the Storage-tree entry, flagged as a judgment call. EXCLUDED-OTHER: Decor > 'Vanities & Storage Furniture' and Storage > 'Storage Furniture' both redirect into /shop/furniture/... with a 'Furniture' breadcrumb - out of scope (Furniture.xlsx territory). Bath > 'Robes & Pajamas' (/shop/bath/robes-pjs/) is a blended pajama(apparel)+robe(textile)+eye-mask listing with no way to isolate a robes-only count - excluded per apparel boundary rather than guessed; a human may want to review this one. Window Hardware (rods/rails/brackets) excluded per textile hardware boundary. Jewelry & Beauty Storage 'All Jewelry & Beauty Storage' aggregate (177 items) superseded by its own clean subcategory pages (Jewelry Boxes & Display, Beauty Storage & Organization) per the parent-URL rule. Rugs 'Rugs By Color' (Blue/Pink/Gray/Neutral) is a color facet over the same catalog as 'Rugs by Category' - only the by-category split was kept to avoid duplication. No qualifying node was found to belong to both Textile and Storage.
